description: Server-side code for handling invoice detail/view/edit page in a SvelteKit application, including data loading, update, cancel, send, mark as paid, and PDF download actions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches invoice, account, contact, organization settings, and template data in parallel; transforms and returns the invoice details for rendering.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles invoice update form submission; constructs invoice payload and sends PUT request to update invoice data.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the invoice via API and redirects to the invoice list.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Triggers sending the invoice via API.

methods.name: markPaid
methods.description: Marks the invoice as paid with provided amount, method, and date.

methods.name: downloadPdf
methods.description: Fetches the invoice PDF from the backend, encodes it in base64, and returns for download.
